title: MediaIndexDocumentUpsertedPayload
description: media.index_document.upserted v1 (OpenVibe.Media; roadmap WS-O task 10). The OpenVibe.Search document of A public, playable VOD or clip page on openvibe.media (readiness playable, visibility public). Sent whenever what Search should hold changed; a VOD or clip that is deleted, made private or stops being playable gets a tombstone. The revision grows with every change. Consumed by OpenVibe.Search ('*.index_document.*'). Envelope: subject { type, id, revision: <document revision> }, visibility internal, actor service:media.
